title: NextTrip Partners with QSTAK to Launch Tokenized Rewards and Unlock New Revenue Opportunities
summary: QSTAK’s exchange offers a way to raise capital without new shares, while NextTrip ties JOURNY.tv viewing and NXT2.0 bookings to redeemable tokens.
body_markdown:
